description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Celes (Holy)

description.text: Increases Holy Runic Blade level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Celes (Holy)]

description.name: Holy Runic Blade Level
description.text: Keeps track of Holy Runic Blade level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Celes (Holy)]
